item.title: Suruga Bay: Japan's Deepest Bay Beneath Mount Fuji — Guide
item.description: Suruga Bay is Japan’s deepest bay, plunging to around 2,500 metres, an extraordinary depth so close to shore that it creates a unique marine environment home to deep-sea creatures and Japan’s only commercial sakura shrimp fishery. For visitors, the bay pairs dramatic views of Mount Fuji rising directly across the water with scenic coastal drives, ports serving remarkably fresh seafood, and a deep-sea aquarium in Numazu dedicated to the strange creatures hauled from its depths.
